create_depth_metric_evaluator: create a DepthMetric instance to evaluate monocular depth estimation predictions against ground truth
compute_depth_metrics: compute d1, d2, d3, abs_rel, sq_rel, rmse, rmse_log, log10, and silog metrics from depth results
process_depth_batch: process a batch of predicted and ground truth depth maps and store masked results for evaluation
generate_eval_mask: generate an evaluation mask using min/max depth bounds and optional NYU crop region
save_depth_predictions: save predicted depth maps as 16-bit PNG files to an output directory with configurable scale factor
